title: Davis briefs Senate intelligence and armed services committee staff in classified settings

tellings.quote: briefed the Senate select committee int of intelligence staff and the Senate armed services committee staff in classified settings what happened is I briefed the first group in 2019

plain: A physicist named Eric Davis says he gave secret briefings to the staff of two US Senate committees, the one that oversees spy agencies and the one that oversees the armed forces. He says he briefed the first group in 2019 and that more followed by 2022, in classified settings. If true, it would mean Congress was being told behind closed doors about what he knows of UFOs.
